description.narrative: Mozambique - Farmer Income Support Project - Rehabilitation of Endemic Areas Activity: Will target smallholders impacted by CLYD control and mitigation measures to engage in crop diversification to generate income during the period of coconut tree re-growth. Dissemination of improved farming practices and market linkages will be done by experienced field agents to: (i) support demonstration trials; (ii) strengthen producer organizations' marketing capacities; and (iii) provide extensive on-farm training in intercropping methods, integrated pest management practices, and CLYD surveillance capabilities.
Provincia de Zambezia
Nampula

sector.narrative: Plant and post-harvest protection and pest control
